title: OpenAI barrels toward IPO that may happen in September
summary: After Elon Musk lost his lawsuit against OpenAI, the company is reportedly resuming preparations for its IPO, potentially in September.
charlotte_impact: An OpenAI IPO would signal significant confidence in the AI sector and attract massive investment. Public market access could provide OpenAI with further capital to solidify its leadership position, putting pressure on other AI companies.

title: xAI burned $6.4B last year — SpaceX’s IPO filing shows why the spending is far from over

title: Musk’s xAI is being sued over its data center generators — now it’s buying $2.8B more
